The features make managing money incredibly easy: • Get paid up to a day early when your salary is due. • Savings Pots help you organise money for different goals. • Savings Challenges make saving more engaging and motivating. • Cashback offers help you earn money back on everyday spending. • Monzo Perks and Extra provide valuable benefits and additional features. • Instant spending notifications keep you in complete control of your finances. • Budgeting tools make it easy to track where every penny goes.
